# Test fixtures (fonts)

Used only by the tests (and never shipped with the editor): the fake Google Fonts server in `tests/fakeGoogle.ts` serves them.

* `roboto-*.woff2 / .ttf` — Roboto, Apache License 2.0 (Google).
* `roboto-ext-400.woff2` — Roboto, latin-ext subset, Apache License 2.0.
* `inter-var-wght.woff2` — Inter variable (wght), SIL Open Font License 1.1, see `LICENSE-inter-OFL.txt`.
